-- a/main/go.mod --
module example.com/amain

go 1.27

require example.com/adep v0.0.0

replace example.com/adep => ../dep

-- a/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"

-- a/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/adep"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(adep.Init()) }

-- a/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/adep

go 1.27

-- a/dep/dep.go --
package adep

import "syscall"

func Init() uintptr {
	r, _, _ := syscall.Syscall(syscall.SYS_GETPID, 0, 0, 0)
	return r
}

-- b/main/go.mod --
module example.com/bmain

require example.com/bdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/bdep => ../dep

-- b/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"

-- b/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/bdep"

func main() { bdep.Raw[int](1) }

-- b/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/bdep

go 1.27

-- b/dep/dep.go --
package bdep

import "syscall"

func Raw[T any](x T) {
	syscall.Syscall(syscall.SYS_GETPID, 0, 0, 0)
}

-- d/dep/dep.go --

import "os/exec"

func Init() {
	exec.Command("/bin/true").Run()
}

-- f/main/go.mod --
module example.com/fmain

go 1.27

-- f/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"

-- f/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"syscall"

	"example.com/fmain/lib"
)

func main() {
	r, _, _ := syscall.Syscall(syscall.SYS_GETPID, 0, 0, 0)
	fmt.Println(r, lib.Init())
}

-- f/main/lib/lib.go --
package lib

import "syscall"

func Init() uintptr {
	r, _, _ := syscall.Syscall(syscall.SYS_GETPID, 0, 0, 0)
	return r
}

-- i/main/go.mod --
module example.com/imain

go 1.27

require example.com/idep v0.0.0

replace example.com/idep => ../dep

-- i/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"

-- i/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/idep"

func main() { idep.Init() }

-- i/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/idep

go 1.27

-- i/dep/dep.go --
package idep

import "os/exec"

type starter interface{ Start() error }

var s starter = mk()

//go:noinline
func mk() starter { return exec.Command("/bin/true") }

func Init() {
	s.Start()
}
